narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same life. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} parted in month {first_bar_apart_month}, with more of the ghost's salary gone before it landed. The layoff came in month {layoff_month}, with the ghost's net worth {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost held {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's Freedom finished at {ghost_freedom}, nearly every rupee of pay claimed before the month opened.
